source.note: Undated product listing on the GRU's official fan shop (linked from rugby.ge as 'shop'); date is the day it was opened. source.name: boutique-rugby.com: Georgia Rugby Home Jersey 2025/2026 - Macron
source.quote: Official Georgia home jersey for the 2025/2026 season. Comfort, style, and national pride by Macron.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Undated retail listing; date is the day it was opened. Macron-GRU imagery: the official 2025/26 home shirt product image carries the Macron hero on the right chest and sleeve; July 2026 Nations Cup match photos (World Rugby/Getty, Uruguay v Georgia, 4 July 2026, Montevideo) show the same. Macron's own announcement page (about.macron.com, 'MACRON TECHNICAL PARTNER OF GEORGIA RUGBY UNION') is Cloudflare-blocked from this network; see PR notes.

summary: Georgia's current home shirt (Macron, worn in the Rugby Europe Championship 2026 and the Nations Cup July 2026) carries TBC Bank - the Georgian Rugby Union's general sponsor, renewed to 2027 - on the upper back of the replica sold in the GRU's official shop. The front is plain (Macron chest logo and GRU crest only, per the official product image on boutique-rugby.com and the GRU shop), the sleeves carry only the Macron hero and a Georgian cross design motif, and the back below the TBC mark and the shorts show no commercial sponsor in Nations Cup match photos (Uruguay v Georgia, 4 July 2026).
shortLine: TBC Bank on the back, plain front
